build_sequential_augmentation: build a Sequential augmentation pipeline that applies a sequence of transforms to images and masks
create_sequential_transforms: create a Sequential module wrapping multiple image/mask transformation functions
run_sequential_forward: run the Sequential forward pass to apply chained transforms with per-transform arguments

review_sequential_args_padding: review the Sequential forward method that pads missing args with None for each transform
